TwentyFourPointGame._generate_cards:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Populates self.nums with exactly 4 randomly chosen integers, each drawn uniformly from 1 to 9 inclusive, then asserts the list contains exactly 4 elements." _generate_cards]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate exactly 4 times using range(4), with loop variable i taking values 0, 1, 2, 3; i is not used in the body RESULT loop_iteration]
            [COMMAND Within each iteration of the loop over i in range(4), call random.randint(1, 9) to obtain a random integer in the fully inclusive range [1, 9], then append that integer to self.nums RESULT self.nums]

        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: len(self.nums) != 4 after the loop completes]
        [LOG "Assertion failed: expected self.nums to contain exactly 4 elements after appending 4 random integers, but found a different count"]

TwentyFourPointGame.get_my_cards:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Resets the instance's number list, populates it by delegating to the internal card-generation routine, and returns the resulting list." get_my_cards]

TwentyFourPointGame.answer:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Validates that a given arithmetic expression uses exactly the digits available in self.nums (with correct multiplicities), then evaluates it; returns the card list if 'pass' is given, or False if the digit usage does not match." answer]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> expression </REF>: string "An arithmetic expression string to validate and evaluate, or the literal string 'pass' to skip validation and return the current hand"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: any "The result of evaluate_expression if all digits match exactly; the card list from get_my_cards if expression is 'pass'; or False if digit usage does not satisfy the required multiset"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty dictionary named statistic to accumulate per-digit frequency counts RESULT statistic]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each character c in expression; if c is a decimal digit (c.isdigit() is true) AND the integer value of c is a member of self.nums, increment statistic[c] by 1, using 0 as the default starting count RESULT statistic]
            [COMMAND Create a shallow copy of statistic and assign it to nums_used, so that subsequent decrements do not alter the original frequency counts RESULT nums_used]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each element num in self.nums; for each num, check whether str(num) exists as a key in nums_used (using sentinel -100 to distinguish absence from a zero count) AND whether nums_used[str(num)] is greater than 0; if both conditions hold (short-circuit AND), decrement nums_used[str(num)] by 1; otherwise immediately return False, ending the method RESULT nums_used]
            [COMMAND After the loop, check whether every value in nums_used equals 0 using all(count == 0 for count in nums_used.values()); if all counts are exactly 0, return the result of self.evaluate_expression(expression); otherwise return False RESULT final_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: expression equals the literal string 'pass']
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the result of self.get_my_cards() immediately, bypassing all validation logic RESULT cards_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During iteration over self.nums, a num is found whose string key is absent from nums_used (sentinel lookup returns -100) or whose count in nums_used has already reached 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False immediately without processing any remaining elements in self.nums RESULT early_false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: After the self.nums loop completes, at least one value in nums_used is non-zero, meaning some tracked digit was counted in expression more times than it appears in self.nums]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False without calling evaluate_expression RESULT excess_false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
TwentyFourPointGame.evaluate_expression:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Evaluates a mathematical expression string and returns true if it equals 24, or false if it does not or if an exception occurs during evaluation." evaluate_expression]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> expression </REF>: string "A mathematical expression string to be evaluated"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "True if the evaluated expression equals exactly 24, false otherwise or on any exception"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Attempt to evaluate the input expression string using eval and compare the result to the integer 24 RESULT eval_result]
            [COMMAND If the evaluated result equals 24, return true RESULT return_true]
            [COMMAND If the evaluated result does not equal 24, return false RESULT return_false]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Any exception is raised during eval or the equality check]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Catch the exception, suppress it, and return false as the default result RESULT return_false_on_exception]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
